title: 第3228章 昊月族第3227章 你们的实力让我失望
slug: 被女帝师父嫌弃的我竟举世无敌
lines: “哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！”
“你们人族真的很有意思，竟然这么喜欢自相残杀。”
“你们这样的种族之所以强大，难道就因为喜欢自相残杀吗？”
就在这时，一道声音响起，瞬间吸引了所有人的注意力，但唯独不包括陈长安。
陈长安很清楚自己是来干什么的，不将这些人杀完，他怎么可能会停下来。
而说话之人看到陈长安竟然不为所动，不由得也是眉头一皱。
“还真是够投入的。”
“可我说话的时间，不喜欢被别人忽视。”
“给我停下来！”
对方身影一闪，直接挡在了陈长安面前。
两人同时出手，陈长安虽然依旧是纹丝不动，但对方竟然也只是轻微的向后退了半步。
“鸿蒙帝尊境巅峰？”
“你是什么人？”
陈长安眉头微皱，有些不解的看着对方，完全搞不懂怎么会突然跑出来这么一个人搅局。
而且这天衍大陆之中，不是说除了圣灵一族之外，最强的就是二宫三神教了吗？
就连二宫三神教都不具备这样的强者，这又是来自于哪个种族？
如果是这样，那又怎么会让二宫三神教占据这么高的地位？
“我是什么人？”
“我可从来没有说过我是人。”
“我可不是你们人族。”
“变成这个样子，只不是方便行走罢了。”
“我呢，也不算是天衍大陆的人吧，我是从其他地方过来的。”
“原本只是想要过来看看，这天衍大陆的圣灵一族实力如何，不过听到了一个弑陈大会，这就打算过来看看热闹。”
“没曾想，这热闹比我想象中的要好看。”
“一个一等鸿蒙极尊境，居然能够屠杀这么多比你修为还要强的人。”
“甚至就算是五等鸿蒙帝尊境也不是你的对手。”
“这真是让我大开眼界啊。”
对方虽然是在夸赞陈长安，可是眼神之中的高傲却怎么也掩饰不住。
或许在他心中，陈长安的存在，更多的像是一种发现了新奇的好玩之物一样。
陈长安也没想到，对方竟然不是天衍大陆的人，而且来这里的目的，恐怕是奔着圣灵一族来的。
content_en:
;;
"Hahahahahaha!"
"You humans are really interesting, you actually like to kill each other so much."
"Is the reason why a race like yours is so powerful because it likes to kill each other?"
At this moment, a voice sounded, instantly attracting everyone's attention, except Chen Changan.
Chen Changan knew very well what he was here to do. How could he stop if he didn't finish killing these people.
When the speaker saw that Chen Changan was unmoved, he couldn't help but frown.
“It’s really dedicated enough.”
"But when I talk, I don't like to be ignored by others."
"Stop it!"
The other party's figure flashed and stood directly in front of Chen Changan.
The two of them took action at the same time. Although Chen Changan remained motionless, the other party only took half a step back slightly.
"The peak of Hongmeng Emperor Realm?"
"Who are you?"
Chen Changan frowned slightly and looked at the other party with some confusion, completely confused as to why such a person would suddenly come out to disrupt the situation.
And in Tianyan Continent, isn’t it said that apart from the Holy Spirit Clan, the strongest one is the Ergong Sanshen Sect?
Even the Ergong Sanshen Sect doesn't have such a strong person. Which race does this come from?
If this is the case, how come the Ergong Sanshen Cult occupies such a high status?
"Who am I?"
"I never said I was human."
"I'm not your human race."
"It's just like this to make it easier to walk."
"As for me, I'm not from Tianyan Continent. I came from other places."
"Originally I just wanted to come over to see how strong the Holy Spirit Clan in Tianyan Continent is, but after hearing about a Chen Killing Conference, I decided to come over and see the excitement."
"I never thought that the excitement would be better than I imagined."
"A first-level Hongmeng Supreme Realm can actually kill so many people who are stronger than you."
"Even the fifth-level Hongmeng Emperor is no match for you."
"It was really eye-opening for me."
Although the other party was praising Chen Changan, he could not hide the arrogance in his eyes.
Perhaps in his mind, Chen Changan's existence was more like discovering a new and interesting thing.
Chen Changan also didn't expect that the other party was not from Tianyan Continent, and the purpose of coming here was probably for the Holy Spirit Clan.
